recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5438 unless a future Security work group decision changes the broader Signature datatype semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5438 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Security issue for FHIR-core-Provenance asking to change Provenance.integritySignature from string to base64Binary; the Jira resolution accepted the change to base64.
initial_application: The request was applied in 2015: commit 5c0d5519e3 explicitly updated Provenance.signature to hold base64Binary for #5438, and commit c455598a28 replaced the old Provenance.integritySignature row with Provenance.signature, cardinality 0..*, type Signature, while also updating Signature-related content for [5438].
additional_context: Provenance is an active resource and Signature is an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. Later related decisions renamed Signature.blob to Signature.data and broadened Signature media-type/documentation support, but preserved the base64Binary signature payload.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. Current source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml has Provenance.signature typed as Signature, and source/datatypes/signature.xml defines Signature.data as base64Binary.

related_jiras.note: Requested a generic Signature resource/datatype; its no-change resolution says the Provenance.signature plus Signature datatype changes supplied the needed structure.
Applied in the same 2015 Provenance/Signature commit family but concerns ASTM signature purpose definitions rather than the payload datatype.
Renamed Signature.blob to Signature.data while preserving the base64Binary payload type.
Broadened Signature media-type/documentation support without changing Signature.data away from base64Binary.
